description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Void Domination] and [Almagest] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Void Domination
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 3], [Instant Cast 3] and Wicked Thoughts +3 after using three of Beckoning Void or Malicious Craving, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Almagest
description.text: Grants Boundless Ambition +1 after using six of Beckoning Void or Malicious Craving, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
